questions.prompt: An operator has Contributor on rg-app and no other roles. There are no deny assignments or other restrictions. Which action is excluded from the permissions granted by Contributor?

options.text: Assign Owner to another user on rg-app.
options.explanation: Contributor excludes Azure role-assignment writes; managing resources does not include granting access.

options.text: Create a storage account in rg-app.
options.explanation: Contributor permits resource creation within its assigned scope.

options.text: Update a virtual machine's configuration in rg-app.
options.explanation: Contributor permits resource configuration changes within its assigned scope.

options.text: Delete a virtual machine in rg-app.
options.explanation: Contributor permits resource deletion within its assigned scope.

questions.prompt: A custom Role A grants virtual-machine management actions but excludes virtual-machine deletion through NotActions. Role B grants virtual-machine deletion. Both roles are assigned to the same user at rg-app, which contains vm-app. No deny assignment or other restriction applies. Which statement describes the user's effective permission to delete vm-app?

options.text: Role B supplies deletion permission even though Role A excludes it.
options.explanation: NotActions subtracts from Role A rather than denying permissions granted by Role B.

options.text: Role A blocks deletion even though Role B grants it.
options.explanation: A NotActions exclusion is not a deny assignment across roles.

options.text: Deletion is allowed only if Role B was assigned after Role A.
options.explanation: Both applicable grants are evaluated; their assignment order does not make one replace the other.

options.text: Deletion is allowed only after removing the exclusion from Role A.
options.explanation: The separate Role B grant already supplies the operation; Role A need not be changed.

questions.prompt: A user must download private blobs using Entra authentication but should not manage storage account configuration. Which listed role matches the data task?

options.explanation: It grants the required Blob read data operations.
Resource configuration read does not include Blob data read.
It grants much broader resource and access administration.
VM management does not authorize these Blob data reads.
